purpose: Public source lineage and style boundary; exact candidate identities and qualification results belong to the delivery evidence.

style_program.basis: Captured canonical style program; reviewed as source, without inherited acceptance.

style_sample.basis: Captured public sample; only explanatory prompt-fidelity comments were revised.

reviewed_corrections: Sort ANSI keys numerically by key string.
Use the installed fallback consistently for startup and manual commands.
Require schema 1 and palette, terminal and completion tables in every present style file; allow partial values and optional ANSI and faces.
Validate closed data grammars before emitting fixed shell assignments and face calls; restrict numeric colors to ASCII digits.
Preserve filesystem refusal for local overrides and output paths; permit hardlinked trusted read-only defaults for Nix optimisation.
Keep rendering explicit and preserve metadata for byte-identical managed output.
Invoke the data script through isolated Python; retain mode 100644.
privacy_boundary: The public sample contains illustrative values. Machine-specific style values remain in the separately managed local control projection and its installed data; they are not source inputs to public core.
